content.title: Institutes II.16: how Christ performed the office of Redeemer
content.author: John Calvin · Henry Beveridge translation (1845), CCEL
content.note: Calvin's chapter on the Redeemer's work in the 1559 Institutes: God's love comes before the reconciliation (sections 2-4); Christ, declared innocent yet condemned, bears the curse in our place (5-6); God was never hostile to his Son even while the Son bore judgment (11). Public domain.
